lines.raw: **Robert Carter**, born 2 May 1957, lives in Houston and has type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure.
lines.say: Robert Carter, born 2 May 1957, lives in Houston and has type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure.

lines.raw: Since January 2024 he has been on a Medicare Advantage plan with drug coverage, **Gulf Coast Advantage (HMO)** from **Gulf Coast Health Plan**, member ID **GC5001**.
lines.say: Since January 2024 he has been on a Medicare Advantage plan with drug coverage, Gulf Coast Advantage (H M O) from Gulf Coast Health Plan, member I D G C 5 0 0 1.

lines.raw: His primary care doctor is **Dr. Nguyen at Bayou Family Medicine** (NPI `1982736450`).
lines.say: His primary care doctor is Doctor Nguyen at Bayou Family Medicine (N P I 1 9 8 2 7 3 6 4 5 0).

lines.raw: All organisations, IDs and numbers here are fictional.
lines.say: All organisations, I D's and numbers here are fictional.

lines.raw: Step 1: Check-up, 10 Feb 2025.
lines.say: Step 1: Check-up, 10 Feb 2025.

lines.raw: Robert sees Dr. Nguyen.
lines.say: Robert sees Doctor Nguyen.

lines.raw: The visit, his blood pressure and his diagnoses (type 2 diabetes `E11.9`, high blood pressure `I10`) go into the clinic's **EHR**.
lines.say: The visit, his blood pressure and his diagnoses (type 2 diabetes E 1 1 . 9, high blood pressure I10) go into the clinic's E H R.

lines.raw: Dr. Nguyen orders an HbA1c test: the EHR sends an **HL7 ORM** order to Bayou Clinical Lab.
lines.say: Doctor Nguyen orders an H b A 1 c test: the E H R sends an HL7 O R M order to Bayou Clinical Lab.

lines.raw: Step 2: Lab result, 11 Feb 2025.
lines.say: Step 2: Lab result, 11 Feb 2025.

lines.raw: The lab sends the result back as an **HL7 ORU** message: HbA1c **9.4%**, LOINC `4548-4`, flagged high.
lines.say: The lab sends the result back as an HL7 O R U message: H b A 1 c 9.4 percent, L O I N C 4 5 4 8 dash 4, flagged high.

lines.raw: It lands in Robert's chart in the EHR.
lines.say: It lands in Robert's chart in the E H R.

lines.raw: Visit summary, 11 Feb 2025.
lines.say: Visit summary, 11 Feb 2025.

lines.raw: The clinic's EHR creates a **C-CDA CCD** for the visit, with his problems, medicines, vitals and the HbA1c result.
lines.say: The clinic's E H R creates a C-CDA C C D for the visit, with his problems, medicines, vitals and the H b A 1 c result.

lines.raw: Its nightly data feed sends the CCD to Gulf Coast Health Plan.
lines.say: Its nightly data feed sends the C C D to Gulf Coast Health Plan.

lines.raw: Step 4: Two claims.
lines.say: Step 4: Two claims.

lines.raw: The clinic bills the visit (CPT `99214`) and the lab bills the test (CPT `83036`), each as an **X12 837P** claim to Gulf Coast Health Plan, often through a clearinghouse.
lines.say: The clinic bills the visit (C P T 9 9 2 1 4) and the lab bills the test (C P T 8 3 0 3 6), each as an X12 8 3 7 P claim to Gulf Coast Health Plan, often through a clearinghouse.

lines.raw: The plan pays and returns **X12 835** remittances.
lines.say: The plan pays and returns X12 8 35 remittances.

lines.raw: Step 5: Reported to CMS.
lines.say: Step 5: Reported to C M S.

lines.raw: Because it is a Medicare Advantage plan, Gulf Coast Health Plan also sends a record of these services to CMS as **encounter data**.
lines.say: Because it is a Medicare Advantage plan, Gulf Coast Health Plan also sends a record of these services to C M S as encounter data.

lines.raw: The Risk Adjustment course explains why CMS wants the diagnoses.
lines.say: The Risk Adjustment course explains why C M S wants the diagnoses.

lines.raw: Step 6: ER visit, 20 May 2025.
lines.say: Step 6: E R visit, 20 May 2025.

lines.raw: Robert feels dizzy and goes to the ER at **Bayou City Medical Center**.
lines.say: Robert feels dizzy and goes to the E R at Bayou City Medical Center.

lines.raw: The hospital sends **HL7 ADT^A04** on arrival and **ADT^A03** when he goes home to the HIE.
lines.say: The hospital sends HL7 A D T ^ A 0 4 on arrival and A D T ^ A 0 3 when he goes home to the H I E.

lines.raw: The HIE matches him by name and birth date and alerts Dr. Nguyen's clinic the same evening.
lines.say: The H I E matches him by name and birth date and alerts Doctor Nguyen's clinic the same evening.

lines.raw: The hospital later bills the plan with an **X12 837I** claim.
lines.say: The hospital later bills the plan with an X12 8 3 7 I claim.

lines.raw: Step 7: His app, June 2025.
lines.say: Step 7: His app, June 2025.

lines.raw: With Emily's help, Robert connects a health app to his plan using **SMART on FHIR**.
lines.say: With Emily's help, Robert connects a health app to his plan using S M A R T on F H I R.

lines.raw: The app calls the **Patient Access API** and shows his claims as FHIR **ExplanationOfBenefit** resources and his HbA1c as an **Observation**, if the plan holds that result.
lines.say: The app calls the Patient Access A P I and shows his claims as F H I R ExplanationOfBenefit resources and his H b A 1 c as an Observation, if the plan holds that result.

lines.raw: Each step, the systems involved and the standard used.
lines.say: Each step, the systems involved and the standard used.

lines.raw: 1. Check-up. From → to: Inside Bayou Family Medicine's EHR. Standard: EHR data (shared later as C-CDA or FHIR). Data produced: Encounter, vitals, problems E11.9 and I10.
lines.say: 1. Check-up. From to to: Inside Bayou Family Medicine's E H R. Standard: E H R data (shared later as C-CDA or F H I R). Data produced: Encounter, vitals, problems E 1 1 . 9 and I10.

lines.raw: 1. Lab order. From → to: Clinic EHR → Bayou Clinical Lab. Standard: HL7 v2 **ORM**. Data produced: Order for HbA1c.
lines.say: 1. Lab order. From to to: Clinic E H R to Bayou Clinical Lab. Standard: HL7 v2 O R M. Data produced: Order for H b A 1 c.

lines.raw: 2. Lab result. From → to: Bayou Clinical Lab → Clinic EHR. Standard: HL7 v2 **ORU**, LOINC. Data produced: HbA1c 9.4%, flag H.
lines.say: 2. Lab result. From to to: Bayou Clinical Lab to Clinic E H R. Standard: HL7 v2 O R U, L O I N C. Data produced: H b A 1 c 9.4 percent, flag H.

lines.raw: 2b. Visit summary. From → to: Clinic EHR → Gulf Coast Health Plan. Standard: **C-CDA** CCD (SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm). Data produced: Problems, medicines, vitals, HbA1c as coded entries.
lines.say: 2b. Visit summary. From to to: Clinic E H R to Gulf Coast Health Plan. Standard: C-CDA C C D (SNOMED C T, L O I N C, RxNorm). Data produced: Problems, medicines, vitals, H b A 1 c as coded entries.

lines.raw: 3. Claims. From → to: Clinic and lab → Gulf Coast Health Plan. Standard: X12 **837P**, then **835** back. Data produced: Two professional claims and two payments.
lines.say: 3. Claims. From to to: Clinic and lab to Gulf Coast Health Plan. Standard: X12 8 3 7 P, then 8 35 back. Data produced: Two professional claims and two payments.

lines.raw: 4. Encounter data. From → to: Gulf Coast Health Plan → CMS. Standard: Encounter data submission. Data produced: Record of the services and diagnoses.
lines.say: 4. Encounter data. From to to: Gulf Coast Health Plan to C M S. Standard: Encounter data submission. Data produced: Record of the services and diagnoses.

lines.raw: 5. ER alert. From → to: Bayou City Medical Center → Gulf Region HIE → Clinic. Standard: HL7 v2 **ADT** A04 and A03. Data produced: Arrival and discharge events, diagnosis R42.
lines.say: 5. E R alert. From to to: Bayou City Medical Center to Gulf Region H I E to Clinic. Standard: HL7 v2 A D T A04 and A03. Data produced: Arrival and discharge events, diagnosis R42.

lines.raw: 5. ER claim. From → to: Bayou City Medical Center → Gulf Coast Health Plan. Standard: X12 **837I**. Data produced: Outpatient hospital claim.
lines.say: 5. E R claim. From to to: Bayou City Medical Center to Gulf Coast Health Plan. Standard: X12 8 3 7 I. Data produced: Outpatient hospital claim.

lines.raw: 6. App. From → to: Gulf Coast Health Plan → Robert's app. Standard: FHIR R4 API, SMART on FHIR, CARIN Blue Button. Data produced: ExplanationOfBenefit resources, Observation.
lines.say: 6. App. From to to: Gulf Coast Health Plan to Robert's app. Standard: F H I R R4 A P I, S M A R T on F H I R, C A R I N Blue Button. Data produced: ExplanationOfBenefit resources, Observation.

lines.raw: You now know why US rules require health data to be shared (HIPAA, HITECH, the Cures Act, the CMS rules), the standards that do the work (X12, NCPDP, HL7 v2, C-CDA, FHIR and the code sets) and the networks that carry them.

lines.raw: Networks such as an **HIE** carry the fast clinical feeds (ADT alerts, documents) between organisations.
lines.say: Networks such as an H I E carry the fast clinical feeds (A D T alerts, documents) between organisations.
